beschreibung:
Spectacular Suspension Bridge over the Ehrenberger Klause

The Highline179 near Reutte in the Tyrolean Außerfern is one of the longest Tibetan-style pedestrian suspension bridges in the world. With a span of 406 metres, this impressive structure hovers at a height of around 114 metres above the historic Ehrenberger Klause and the federal highway 179.

Historic Fortress Landscape and Panoramic Views

The suspension bridge connects the historic fortress complex of Burgenwelt Ehrenberg with Fort Claudia on the opposite side. Stepping across the gently swaying grating, visitors enjoy spectacular views of the surrounding Lechtaler and Allgäuer Alpen as well as the historic fortifications.
